author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
FSR is getting really good.  It is so good that if you don't pay close attention to it, you can't really tell the difference between a native frame and a FSR frame.  AMD finally caught up in the game of fake frames.

reshared_post.author_headline: Senior Vice President & General Manager, Computing and Graphics Group at AMD
reshared_post.reshared_text:
🚀 Today we launch the driver that activates AMD FSR Redstone… pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in real-time graphics and a critical step in our strategy to redefine the future of gaming.

FSR Redstone delivers three breakthrough machine learning-powered, real-time features that elevate both visuals and gameplay:

💡 Radiance Caching – predicts indirect lighting to reduce ray tracing computation, enabling richer, more cinematic visuals without sacrificing performance

✨ Ray Regeneration – refinement of ray-traced details, making reflections, shadows, and surfaces sharper and more realistic

🎮 ML Frame Generation – delivers smoother, more immersive action for fast-paced gameplay, trained on gaming’s most demanding scenarios

This launch is the result of incredible co-engineering across the industry.  To our developers, partners, and the gaming community: thank you.  The next chapter starts now.
